[
A Weekend In Washington D.C.
](/blog/a-weekend-in-washington-dc)
We had an amazing weekend exploring Washington, D.C., packed with history, art, and some seriously cool sights! Walking the National Mall felt like stepping into a postcard with monuments everywhere! We even caught a glimpse of the White House (because, of course, we had to!).
The National Gallery of Art was a total dream for any art love, and then there was the Smithsonian National Museum of Natural History… where we geeked out over towering dinosaurs, sparkling gemstones, and the famous Hope Diamond (seriously, that thing is massive!).
D.C. definitely did not disappoint, and we left with tired feet, a camera roll full of memories, and a newfound appreciation for just how much there is to see and do in our nation’s capital.
[Read More](/blog/a-weekend-in-washington-dc)

Lucky Charm 5k
We spent Saturday in Harrisburg, Pennsylvania photographing and cheering on runners who ran the Lucky Charm 5k. My fiancé’s brother, Andy has run in a few races and invited our son Oliver to participate in this one with him.
The day started out calling for rain and I wasn’t too sure what to expect or how to prepare for it. Thankfully, I didn’t have to. The rain held off and the weather was beautiful!
Oliver did so well! It was s such an accomplishment for him to finish. He’s already preparing (mentally) for the next one!
Here are some photos from the race!

https://www.paulettemichelle.com/paulett.content:
Hey there, I’m Paulette!
I’m a portrait photographer based in Northeast Pennsylvania, and I see the world a little differently, I see it through a lens filled with magic, emotion, and story. Photography, for me, isn’t just about snapping pictures; it’s about capturing the feeling of a moment, the spark of a personality, and the beauty in everyday life.
NEPA is my home and my inspiration. The rolling hills, the changing seasons, the golden light filtering through the trees…it all feeds my creativity. But more than the landscapes, it’s the people who make this place special. Whether I’m photographing an artist lost in their craft, a couple in love, or a quiet, powerful portrait, my goal is always the same: to create images that feel like memories, not just pictures.
My journey with photography has been an adventure of growth, storytelling, and chasing the perfect light. Over the years, I’ve refined my craft, learning how to shape light, compose stories, and bring out authentic emotions in my subjects. I believe that every photograph should tell a story, and that’s exactly what I strive for in every session.
So, take a look around. Whether you’re here to find a photographer, get inspired, or just explore the world through my lens, welcome. Let’s create something unforgettable together.
